translations.web: “For from their least even to their greatest, everyone is given to covetousness. From the prophet even to the priest, everyone deals falsely.
translations.bsb: “For from the least of them to the greatest, all are greedy for gain; from prophet to priest, all practice deceit.
translations.kjv: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
translations.asv: For from the least of them even unto the greatest of them every one is given to covetousness; and from the prophet even unto the priest every one dealeth falsely.
